name: grad-linkedin-pack
description: 28 Claude Skills for an honest LinkedIn presence in your own voice, from an empty profile to a 20-minute weekly routine: an experience inventory interview, a target role brief from real job ads, a personal voice guide and a personal AI use policy; a headline, an About section, experience entries, education and projects entries, a skills section and a profile audit; a project interview, a one-page project case study, a Featured section plan and a recommendation request; a post ideas bank, learning, project and milestone posts and a voice check on any AI-assisted draft; a follow list, thoughtful comments and connection request notes; Open to Work settings, a recruiter reply with a scam check first and an alumni search plan; plus a 20-minute weekly routine, an activity log and a monthly profile refresh. For final-year students and new graduates. Each skill is one named method or one artifact, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template, a finish line and the next skill to run.
